newsitem.title: USA: Pepco, RCN plan phone, web, cable venture.
newsitem.headline: Pepco, RCN plan phone, web, cable venture.

text.p: Potomac Electric Power Co RCN Corp plans to announce a joint venture to offer Washington area consumers alternative local telephone service, high-speed Internet connections and cable television, the Washington Post reported in Wednesday editions.
The two companies plan to invest $300 million over the next three years to expand Pepco's 350-mile fiber optic network so that it can reach area homes.

The services, to be priced below those of existing providers, would be offered first in the District of Columbia and then extended throughout the 6.6 million-household Washington-Baltimore region, according to the newspaper report.
Pepco and RCN will announce the venture at a news conference in Washington on Wednesday.
